The '''Crypt rat''' can be found under the [[Barrows]] tunnels. Despite their combat level, they are weaker than they appear unless they come in large amounts. Due to the disgusting appearance of the crypt rat, not even a [[cat]] will try to catch it.

They do not pose a large threat to most players, but with many of them together along with other monsters, they become an annoyance. They are far stronger than regular [[rat]]s, and are aggressive.

They can be handy as they can be used to heal if the player completing the barrows activity has [[Guthan the Infested's equipment|Guthan's armour]]. Crypt rats are only aggressive for 10 minutes, after which they gain [[tolerance]].

These are widely seen as a great way to get kill count in [[Barrows]], as they can be killed quickly and don't pose much of a threat to players.
